Checked 2026-10-27. Source of truth: `data/eval/episodes.yaml` plus the
series store in `data/series/` (original-vintage files only; the October
retrospective snapshot is deliberately excluded).

An episode is **confirmed** only when an observation satisfying its claim had
already been *published* by the episode's as-of date. An observation released
later cannot confirm an earlier anchor. Series confirm that a move happened;
they are never evidence for an edge (proposal section 10).

**3 of 8 episodes are confirmed as declared**, of which 2 against official data.

## What each disposition means for the query set

### confirmed — usable as declared

- **May 2026 rupee record low** (`ep-may-rupee-low`) — 'inr_usd' observation on 2026-05-20 of 96.8441, published 2026-05-20, satisfies 'USD/INR at or above 96.8, the weakest level of the window'.
  Source: https://www.fbil.org.in/wasdm/refrates/fetchfiltered?fromDate=2026-5-1&toDate=2026-5-31&authenticated=false
- **Mid-2026 CPI acceleration past 4 per cent** (`ep-cpi-acceleration`) — 'cpi_headline_yoy' observation on 2026-06-30 of 4.38, published 2026-07-13, satisfies 'Headline CPI inflation at or above 4.0 per cent year on year'.
  Source: https://mospi.gov.in/uploads/latestReleases/latest_release_1783937698596_1013f1a1-3400-41aa-b4f4-5bbff10db7b7_Press_Release_of_CPI_for_June_2026.pdf
- **March 2026 foreign portfolio outflow** (`ep-mar-fpi-outflow`) — 'fpi_flows_usd_mn' observation on 2026-03-31 of -13600.0, published 2026-04-13, satisfies 'Net FPI flows at or below -10,000 USD million for the month'.
  Source: https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/forex/rupee-falls-most-in-two-weeks-as-oil-spikes-on-us-move-to-blockade-iran-ports/article70857133.ece

### redate — usable only at a later as-of date

- **March 2026 crude oil shock** (`ep-mar-oil-shock`) — 'Brent crude at or above $100 a barrel' is satisfied in 'brent_usd_bbl', but the earliest satisfying observation was published on 2026-04-01, after the proposed as-of date 2026-03-20.
  Source: https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/commodities/news/front-month-brent-oil-futures-extend-gains-after-record-monthly-rise-in-march/articleshow/129939258.cms

### unconfirmed — not usable; drop or restate

- **September 2026 bond sell-off** (`ep-sep-bond-selloff`) — no observation in 'gsec_10y_pct' satisfies 'Ten-year G-sec yield at or above 7.0 per cent' at any as-of date; the series holds 6 observation(s).

### no_series — document-confirmed only

- **April 2026 ATF price increase** (`ep-apr-atf-increase`) — ATF_PRICE has no series in the store, so the move cannot be series-confirmed; this anchor is document-confirmed only.
- **June 2026 RBI policy meeting** (`ep-jun-rbi-meeting`) — REPO_RATE has no series in the store, so the move cannot be series-confirmed; this anchor is document-confirmed only.
- **August 2026 RBI policy meeting** (`ep-aug-rbi-meeting`) — REPO_RATE has no series in the store, so the move cannot be series-confirmed; this anchor is document-confirmed only.
